result.summary: Fixes an intermittent race condition in the `p2p_ping_ibd` functional test by syncing with a ping after the node receives the last block. This guarantees the node finishes block processing and sets `m_last_block_time` before mocktime advances.
result.problem: In `p2p_ping_ibd`, `getblockcount` can observe the updated tip before `m_last_block_time` is updated. Advancing mocktime in this gap stamps the block with the bumped time, causing the subsequent mocktime advancement to miss the ping timeout boundary and flakily fail CI runs.
evidence: Author provides a failing CI job link demonstrating test flakiness: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/40589303246/job/122489039018
Commit message notes the race was introduced in merged PR #36080.
result.card: Fixes an intermittent failure in the `p2p_ping_ibd` functional test by adding a ping sync before advancing mocktime. In current tests, a race between `ProcessNewBlock()` returning and `m_last_block_time` being stamped causes ping timeout checks to occasionally fail in CI. A failing CI run from test introduction in PR #36080 demonstrates the issue.

risk.why: Touches only functional test code for ping timeouts during IBD.
